mission: Produce one complete, evidence-bound, accessible, channel-appropriate final candidate from an exact governance-prechecked brief.

conditions: An exact lesson brief has passed Governance precheck.

requirements: Names exactly one output contract and one channel context.
Brief revision and SHA-256 match the precheck.
Verdict is pass for the exact brief revision.
Every material claim maps to an approved fact or evidence reference.
Defines format, completeness, accessibility, assets, and review requirements.

outputs.purpose: Contains one complete final candidate, metadata, evidence map, accessibility notes, and exact asset references.

quality_rules: Deliver complete value inside the artifact.
Do not invent users, results, timing, screenshots, footage, quotations, or proof.
End with a useful recap rather than an engagement or promotional CTA.
Any material revision requires a new Governance review.
stop_conditions: Brief or precheck revision does not match.
Required asset rights or privacy status is unknown.
The request asks for publication, upload, send, reply, or fan-out.
